title: 🌐 Eurozone Expansion — Bulgaria Adopts Euro as Official Currency (21st Member State)
summary: Bulgaria adopted the Euro (replacing Bulgarian lev) on 1 January 2026, becoming the 21st member of the Eurozone (6 EU nations remain outside).
